fact: Bank of Uganda stated on 3 December 2025 that it commenced licensing payment system operators, payment service providers and issuers of payment instruments in March 2021 under the National Payment Systems Act, Cap 59 and its regulations, and listed more than 50 licensees including non-bank mobile money operators and fintechs.
title: Issuance of Licences under the National Payment Systems Act, Cap 59: Public Notice
